description: Header file defining structures, macros, and function prototypes for NVRAM variable manipulation in embedded systems, including functions for reading, writing, and managing NVRAM data.

classes.name: nvram_header
classes.description: Structure representing the header of an NVRAM data block.

classes.name: nvram_tuple
classes.description: Linked list node representing an NVRAM variable with name and value.

classes.name: nvram_handle
classes.description: Structure representing an open handle to NVRAM, including file descriptor, memory map, and variable hash.

methods.name: nvram_header
methods.description: Returns the header information from an NVRAM handle.

methods.name: nvram_set
methods.description: Sets the value of an NVRAM variable.

methods.name: nvram_get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an NVRAM variable.

methods.name: nvram_open
methods.description: Opens NVRAM device and returns a handle.

methods.name: nvram_close
methods.description: Closes NVRAM handle and frees resources.

methods.name: nvram_safe_get
methods.description: Safely retrieves an NVRAM variable value, returns empty string if NULL.

methods.name: hndcrc8
methods.description: Computes CRC8 checksum over input data.

methods.name: nvram_to_staging
methods.description: Copies NVRAM contents to staging file.

methods.name: staging_to_nvram
methods.description: Copies staging file contents back to NVRAM.

methods.name: nvram_find_staging
methods.description: Finds the staging file for NVRAM.
